svg.title: GitHub Workflows Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Four GitHub Action workflows shown as columns: CI Pipeline, Security Scan, Continuous Training, and CD ArgoCD Sync

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What branches trigger the CI and Security workflows?')
sendPrompt('What does the monthly schedule trigger?')
sendPrompt('What is a workflow_run trigger?')
sendPrompt('What happens when new data is pushed?')
sendPrompt('What linting tools are used for the AI microservice?')
sendPrompt('How are AI unit tests run in CI?')

sendPrompt('What does the backend build do?')
sendPrompt('How is the React frontend built?')
sendPrompt('What does npm run build produce?')

sendPrompt('What does cargo build --release produce?')
sendPrompt('What does TruffleHog and GitGuardian scan for?')
sendPrompt('What languages does CodeQL analyse?')
sendPrompt('What dependency scanners are used?')
sendPrompt('What is the code quality job checking?')
sendPrompt('How does the Docker build and scan work with Trivy and Grype?')
sendPrompt('What does Semgrep scan for?')
sendPrompt('What is a SBOM and why generate one?')
sendPrompt('What does the security summary job aggregate?')
sendPrompt('Why does CT checkout use Git LFS?')

sendPrompt('What does the CT test step verify before training?')

sendPrompt('How does ArgoCD CLI get installed in the workflow?')

svg.text: CD only fires on development | main
Security: all jobs run if: always()
Git push uses [skip ci] to avoid loop
